pages.text: $(4)Akaishi Fire Necklace$(0) (necklace slot, 1M buffer): spends $(4)20$(0) energy/tick to keep Fire Resistance I up — bathe in lava if you like.
$(4)Akaishi Blast Charm$(0) (body slot, 1M buffer): cancels explosion damage at "1 point = 100 energy".$(br2)Until the buffer runs dry, you're a walking fortress.
Shared mechanics and the slot map live in the $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l) overview; carry spare $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l) when your armor of energy runs thin.
